entities.name: Hazduhr
entities.description: The Abbot of Onella, the Venerable Abbot, last Abbot chosen by Serra before she left Ulgrotha; elderly and failing around 3800 AR.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Chooses the Abbot of Onella from the people of Onella.

entities.name: Onella
entities.description: Place of the people from whom the Abbot is chosen.

entities.name: Aysen
entities.description: The people whose spiritual and moral well-being the Abbot was responsible for.

events.summary: Serra chooses Hazduhr as Abbot of Onella for his potential and open-mindedness.
events.quote: was chosen by Serra from the people of Onella

events.summary: Hazduhr grows old and ill around 3800 AR, raising fears that Serra will not appear to choose a successor.
events.quote: It was feared that, when he died, Serra would not appear to choose a successor.

relations.quote: was chosen by Serra from the people of Onella

relations.note: Responsible for their spiritual and moral well-being.
relations.quote: responsible for the spiritual and moral well-being of all Aysen
